items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the income tax assessment
items.quote: Wer diesen Bescheid für fehlerhaft hält, kann dagegen innerhalb eines Monats Einspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 19.11.2026, no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date stated, so the printed date counts as the posting day. Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025, delivery is deemed on the 4th day after posting (section 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, PostModG), counting calendar days and not counting the posting day itself: day+1 = Fri 20.11, day+2 = Sat 21.11, day+3 = Sun 22.11, day+4 = Mon 23.11.2026. Since this 4th day (Mon 23.11.2026) is a normal working day, no further shift is needed for delivery. Deemed delivery date = 23.11.2026. The one-month Einspruch period (section 355 Abs. 1 AO) runs per sections 187 Abs.1, 188 Abs.2 BGB: the delivery day itself is not counted, and the period ends one month later on the day bearing the same date number, i.e. 23.12.2026. 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Saarland, so no weekend/holiday shift applies.
